method: each mutant applied to the file, usecases/bluedot-grant/build_document.py run to regenerate document.ve.md and causal.ve.md, the tests run, then git checkout restores the files
trust_mutants: N.A.: tools/trust_mutants.py --plan on this branch gives {definitions: 0, mutants: 0}; no Lean changes

mutants.behaviour: row 1: the vex legend carries note 4 in full
rows 1-6: carrying() appends the source sentence to the legend
row 5: the causal.ve.md legend of mandatory_proof carries the NEW contribution sentence
mutants.change: mandatory_proof keeps the bare legend 'mandatory proof'

mutants.behaviour: rows 6 and 7: the old_text legend carries note 1 in full
mutants.change: DEFINES_OLD drops ', the current form text'

mutants.behaviour: the no-invented-content guard exempts a quoted run only when source.md has it verbatim
mutants.change: the vex legend quotes 'VEX is presented as invented', which source.md does not contain

mutants.behaviour: _without_quoted_source drops a quoted run only when source.md has it verbatim
mutants.change: the condition 'm.group(1) in source' becomes 'm.group(1) in source or True' (every quote dropped)
